templates.label: Raster
templates.description: Render your World into a color image using editable raster shaders.

templates.label: Forward lit
templates.description: Render authored World materials, textures and direct lights with the portable forward profile.

templates.label: Visibility buffer + depth
templates.description: Write original primitive and instance IDs into RGBA8, alongside depth. Exports both attachments with one shared render size. Uses opaque static triangles.

templates.label: Visibility + secondary rays
templates.description: Rasterize visibility and depth, reconstruct the first surface, then trace one reflected secondary ray. Samples authored emission and environment lighting. Requires native ray tracing.

templates.label: ReSTIR DI — mesh emitter lighting
templates.description: Three ray passes with editable shader settings and automatically sized reservoirs. Uses emissive meshes and requires native ray tracing. Temporal reuse has no motion reprojection. Change settings through Properties or the canvas menu.

templates.label: Tiled vbuffer NEE — many-light direct lighting
templates.description: Rasterize visibility, build one emitter-selection table per 16×16 tile, then shade each pixel with a light sample and a BSDF ray, MIS-weighted. Uses emissive meshes and requires native ray tracing.

templates.label: Compute ray tracing — primary hits + direct lighting
templates.description: Two scene compute passes: one records each pixel's primary hit in an automatically sized buffer, the next rebuilds the surface and shades emission plus one shadowed light sample, then Accumulate and ToneMap. Requires native ray tracing.

templates.label: Simple compute ray tracing — triangle loop
templates.description: One compute pass loops over every World triangle, keeps the closest hit and displays its unlit material color plus emission; misses show the environment. No shadow rays or bounces. Uses the native ray-capable scene runtime.

templates.label: Veach & Guibas MIS — light vs BSDF sampling
templates.description: Multiple importance sampling from Veach and Guibas (1995): after a primary-hits pass, three shading passes estimate direct lighting with one light sample and one BSDF sample combined by the balance, power, cutoff or maximum heuristic, with the light sample alone, and with the BSDF sample alone. Each image is accumulated and exported for comparison; the MIS image is shown first. Requires native ray tracing.

templates.label: ReSTIR DI — mesh emitter lighting
templates.description: Three ray passes with two automatically sized reservoirs and Graph settings. Connect scene, view and color; requires native ray tracing and emissive meshes.

templates.label: Tiled vbuffer NEE — many-light direct lighting
templates.description: Visibility raster, a per-tile emitter table and an MIS shading pass sharing one automatically sized buffer. Connect scene, view and color; outputs color, visibility and depth. Requires native ray tracing and emissive meshes.

templates.label: Compute ray tracing — primary hits + direct lighting
templates.description: A primary-hits scene compute pass and a shading pass that share one automatically sized hit buffer. Connect scene, view and color; outputs color. Requires native ray tracing.

templates.label: Simple compute ray tracing — triangle loop
templates.description: One compute pass loops over every World triangle, keeps the closest hit and displays its unlit material color plus emission; misses show the environment. No shadow rays or bounces. Uses the native ray-capable scene runtime.

templates.label: Veach & Guibas MIS — light vs BSDF sampling
templates.description: A primary-hits scene compute pass and three shading passes that share one automatically sized hit buffer: MIS of a light and a BSDF sample (Veach and Guibas), the light sample alone and the BSDF sample alone. Connect scene, view and color; outputs color plus optional lightSampling and bsdfSampling images. Requires native ray tracing.

templates.label: Visibility buffer + depth
templates.description: Write RGBA8 primitive/instance IDs and depth. Connect scene, view, visibility and depth; both attachments are exposed as outputs. Uses opaque static triangles.

templates.label: Visibility + secondary rays
templates.description: Rasterize visibility/depth, reconstruct the surface and trace one reflected ray. Connect scene, view and color; outputs color, visibility and depth. Requires native ray tracing.
